mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong GDP growth, or GDP growth rate does not lead to increased consumer spending.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 4.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with low unemployment, or unemployment rate does not lead to increased consumer spending.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in unemployment rate indicate a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong housing starts and low unemployment, or housing starts and unemployment rate do not lead to increased consumer spending.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates a growing economy, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong industrial production, or industrial production does not lead to higher corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in GDP growth rate indicate an easing monetary cycle and a growing economy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with easing monetary cycle and strong GDP growth, or federal funds rate and GDP growth rate do not lead to increased consumer spending.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate and a strong increase in payroll employment indicate a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with low unemployment and strong payroll employment, or unemployment rate and payroll employment do not lead to increased consumer spending.

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales and a low unemployment rate indicate a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong retail sales and low unemployment, or retail sales and unemployment rate do not lead to increased consumer spending.
